info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Loan Application Collateral-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of collateral information for loan applications. By allowing users to register collateral details, it enhances the loan application process and mitigates financial risks. Ideal for financial institutions and developers integrating loan management systems, this API ensures that collateral data is accurately associated with specific loan applications. Typical use cases include the registration of assets such as property or vehicles to secure loans effectively.

post.summary: Create a collateral for a specific loan application.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a collateral associated with a specific loan application. Ensure that all required fields are populated in the request to successfully add the collateral.

requestBody.description: The request body contains the relevant information needed to add new collaterals to a specific loan application identified by RES-100045. This includes details about the collateral type, value, and any associated identification or documentation required for processing.

collateralType.description: The type of collateral being provided.

ownershipType.description: The ownership structure of the collateral (e.g., sole, joint).

ownerCustomerIds.description: A list of customer IDs that own the collateral.

lienPriority.description: Indicates the priority of the lien on the collateral.
